mentions.name: geforcenow-awdl0
mentions.description: A macOS utility that stops Apple Wireless Direct Link (AWDL) from interrupting GeForce NOW cloud gaming. It began as a shell script, was first written in Rust, and was rewritten in Swift to keep dependencies to a minimum. Built with Claude's assistance over a weekend.
mentions.problem: Apple Wireless Direct Link interrupts GeForce NOW on macOS.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built a bit of software[1] with Claude this weekend to stop Apple Wireless Direct Link from interrupting GeForce NOW on macOS. Bit of an upgrade from a shell script[2].
